notes: retry_after_release: a market entry skipped 'already in symbol' may take the setup's next FRESH signal on that symbol (latest bar, later than the blocked bar, full _enter checks) once the symbol is no longer held or pending; once per setup/symbol/day; rebuilt from the journal after a restart; journaled with info.retry_after_release. longs_first_on_ties: same-poll signals on one symbol are entered longs first, setup_order kept within each side. title: Per-lot stacking: up to 3 same-side lots per symbol in every account, each its own bracket, management and journal row
approved_by: owner 2026-10-13 ('Roll this out immediately for today in all accounts'; 3 lots per stock) - mid-session override
notes: Each setup's bracket is a lot (id = parent client order id). Opposite side stays blocked ('opposite side held'); 4th lot blocked ('lot cap'); a setup never stacks on itself. Lot-specific stop moves and time-stop exits (-x client ids); reconcile pairs per parent (legs, -x exit, flatten). Slots and per-setup caps count lots. To verify live: Alpaca wash-trade rejects on stacked entries (journaled 'rejected'), qty reservation per bracket, nested legs after stop replace. Revert: live.max_lots_per_symbol: 1.
plain: Every setup can now take its trade even when another setup already holds the same stock in the same direction (up to 3 per stock); each trade keeps its own stop, target and results.
impact: More trades in every account (mostly Testing 2 and Testing 1), some stocks held by 2-3 setups at once; opposite-side clashes still blocked and simulated.

title: Stacking fix: reconcile never pairs a lot with a sibling lot's leg; lots close only when fully accounted (qty-weighted exits, partial fills exact)
approved_by: lead (accounting fix to the owner-approved stacking), merged after hours
notes: Root cause: the flatten fallback took any opposite-side fill after a lot's entry, including a sibling lot's stop leg (Alpaca lists replaced/leg orders separately); the lot was booked 'flatten' and released while its shares were still held. Now: orders are linked to their own lot (legs, replacements, -x exit); a lot with a working leg stays open; flatten closes are allocated by qty; partial exits are qty-weighted (meta exit_parts). max_lots=1 unchanged. RW6G1 checked: wired correctly, rare in its 09:50-11:30 window (the -FD twin fired 22x on 10-13).
plain: Fixed bookkeeping for stacked trades: a trade is only recorded as closed when its own shares are actually closed, so per-setup results match the broker.
impact: Testing 1/2 journals match broker equity again from tomorrow; stacked lots are no longer released early.

Opposite side and the 3-lot cap still block. retry_after_release is off when re-entry is on (superseded). Caveat: most lab setups emit only the first qualifying bar of the day, so re-entries fire only for setups that evaluate the latest bar - letting every setup re-fire needs a setup-level change (research parity), proposed separately. Copy-skip NOT adopted (owner: let it ride).
plain: A setup can now take the same stock again later in the day on a new signal (up to 3 positions per stock); it can't take the same stock twice on the same signal.
impact: More entries for setups that re-signal during the day; order ids now end with the signal time.
